description:
Buy a number on the user's own carrier account, point it at the trunk, and register it. The CARRIER CHARGES THE USER'S ACCOUNT at its own price; Wixzel sells no numbers and adds nothing. Only on a trunk with can_buy_numbers. Find the number with search_available_numbers first, then tell the user the number and its monthly_cost and upfront_cost in its currency, and buy only after they say yes. Pass the country and type you searched with. An approved regulatory bundle or compliance application already on the carrier account is attached automatically; if the carrier still refuses, relay its message, which says where to get one. purchase_status "pending" means the carrier is still processing the order. Needs the phone_numbers:purchase scope, which the user grants separately.

Requires scope `phone_numbers:purchase`.

country.description: Two-letter country code you searched in, e.g. "IN".

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for safe retries. Generated automatically when omitted. Reuse the SAME value when retrying the SAME logical request; never reuse it for a different one.

inbound_agent_id.description: Agent that answers inbound calls to the number. Also becomes its caller id if it has none.

sip_trunk_id.description: A trunk with can_buy_numbers. See list_sip_trunks.

name: purchase_phone_number
title: Buy a phone number
